name: Approval without vote
title: RECOMMENDATION FOR SECOND READING on the Council position at first reading with a view to the adoption of a directive of the European Parliament and of the Council on driving licences, amending Directive (EU) 2022/2561 of the European Parliament and of the Council, Regulation (EU) 2018/1724 of the European Parliament and of the Council and repealing Directive 2006/126/EC of the European Parliament and of the Council and Commission Regulation (EU) No 383/2012
part_text:
The European Parliament has approved a new set of common rules on driving licences across the European Union. The rules introduce a mobile driving licence that all member countries recognise, clarify minimum ages for drivers, set basic medical fitness requirements and default validity periods, and strengthen rules for new drivers. They also allow supervised driving schemes across countries and set specific rules for certain vehicles, such as emergency vehicles, motorhomes and vehicles using alternative fuels. The aim is safer roads and easier movement between countries.

- New rules cover mobile licences, minimum ages, medical fitness, validity periods and new-driver rules.
- They affect drivers in all European Union countries, including new drivers and drivers of special vehicle types.
- Parliament approved the agreed text; it now goes for signing and publication before becoming law.
